the operational semantics of a probabilistic λ-calculus with constraints is well-defined, and that trace MCMC correctly samples from this distribution.

the operational semantics of a probabilistic language can be defined in a way that is faithful to the semantics of the underlying programming language, even when the language has continuous distributions and constraints.
